Issued at 05:50 AM 23 October 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Cebu(Minglanilla, CityOfTalisay, ToledoCity, CityOfNaga), #Antique(Sebaste, Hamtic, AniniY), #Guimaras(Jordan, Buenavista) and #Iloilo(Ajuy) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Guimaras(NuevaValencia), #Antique(TobiasFornier, Libertad, Pandan), #Iloilo(Concepcion, SanJoaquin), #Aklan(Nabas), #Palawan(Cagayancillo, Quezon, Bataraza and Balabac) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
